text: Hey Shaked - so a core condition for the partner visa is that both partners have to maintain their "center of life" in Israel. Generally this is interpreted as meaning that they must be physically present in Israel at least 75% of a visa year (roughly 9 months). Around 90 days per visa year is generally considered the practical upper limit for time abroad, with some branches applying this more strictly than others. Also very long trips abroad are likely to cause more problems than multiple smaller ones
